=SELECT 
  id,
  keyword_principal,
  search_volume,
  competition,
  source,
  project_name
FROM keywords 
WHERE status = 'pending'
{{ $json.body?.project_name ? "  AND project_name = '" + $json.body.project_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "" }}
ORDER BY search_volume DESC NULLS LAST
{{ $json.body?.limit ? "LIMIT " + $json.body.limit : "LIMIT 100" }}

=INSERT INTO keywords (
  cluster_name,
  keyword_principal,
  keywords_secundarias,
  status,
  processed_at,
  source
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.cluster_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.keyword_principal.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.keywords_secundarias }}'::jsonb,
  'processed',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  'clustering'
)
ON CONFLICT (keyword_principal) 
DO UPDATE SET
  cluster_name = EXCLUDED.cluster_name,
  keywords_secundarias = EXCLUDED.keywords_secundarias,
  status = 'processed',
  processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING id, keyword_principal, cluster_name;

WITH kw AS (
  SELECT UNNEST(
    {{ 
      ($json.all_keywords?.length || 0) > 0
        ? "ARRAY[" +
            $json.all_keywords
              .map(k => "'" + String(k).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'")
              .join(",") +
          "]"
        : "ARRAY[]::text[]"
    }}
  ) AS k
)
UPDATE keywords
SET
  status = 'archived',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE
  keyword_principal IN (SELECT k FROM kw)
  AND id <> '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND status = 'pending';
